purpose: H15 version 2: same claim, contract thresholds, oracle, Gate-0 inputs and DSL baseline as H15 v1; amended sidecar boundary per protocol/AUTHOR_DECISIONS_2026-10-03.md decision 1. Frozen BEFORE any v2 encoding exists.
unchanged: protocol/H15_GATE0.json (oracle, generators, domains/*/ir.json v1, DSL baseline, ambiguity classes)

record_may_hold: identifier spellings, INCLUDING the id that a reference points to (ids are metadata outside the language)
opaque expression/reference strings as in v1
line_must_carry: the ROLE of every reference slot (what kind of thing it points to and in which relation)
amended_sidecar_boundary.record_keys: neutral positional keys L<line>.a<slot>, slots numbered left to right; no structural key names

meaning_rule.text: Every combination of OpenPona words must have a meaning. Labels without meaning must not exist.
operational: Every line instantiates a rule from a frozen phrase table; every phrase in the table has a canon-gloss justification (as in v1 openpona_encoding.md).
No phrase may exist only to distinguish one resource from another (no enumerated 'pi X Y' labels or any other numbering scheme).

Bounded-vocabulary test (machine check of the rule): over generated packages grouped by size (resource count), the number of DISTINCT surface phrases (lines with atoms masked) must not grow with package size beyond the phrase-table size; growth with size = enumeration = rule violated -> H15 v2 REJECTED (reject_if R3 'indispensable sidecar' or cipher).
References use canon binding (e.g. '<head> ni' = 'this <head>, bound in the record'); coreference between lines is equality of record atoms (ids), which is metadata.

audit_procedure_v2: Alpha-renaming: bijective renaming of record atom VALUES (same value -> same new value); compile must equal the renamed IR.
Line-only shape: replace atoms by value-consistent kind-valid placeholders; the compiled IR must equal the original IR under the same substitution.
Record-key vocabulary check as in v1.
Bounded-vocabulary test as above, reported with the per-size counts.

experiment.authoritative_exp_id: exp-h15-v2-001 (run by the orchestrator in an isolated worktree)
